prompt:
You are a meticulous equity research assistant. Compile valuation inputs for the publicly listed company with ticker "BSBR" (the ticker may carry an exchange suffix such as .SI, .HK, .L, .T, .AS). Use the most recent figures you know. Never invent numbers: use null for anything you do not know.

Reply with ONLY one JSON object, no other text, in exactly this shape:
{
 "ticker": "BSBR", "name": "company name", "exchange": "primary exchange",
 "currency": "reporting currency of the financial statements, ISO code",
 "priceCurrency": "trading currency of this listing, ISO code",
 "fxToPriceCurrency": number (1 unit of reporting currency in price currency; 1 if the same),
 "price": last known share price in priceCurrency, "priceDate": "YYYY-MM",
 "fiscalYearEnd": "month",
 "revenueHistory": [{"fy":"FY2020","revenue":number}, ...]  (the last 6 completed fiscal years, oldest first, in MILLIONS of reporting currency),
 "dilutedSharesHistory": [{"fy":"FY2020","shares":number}, ...]  (weighted diluted shares for the same 6 years, oldest first, in MILLIONS, split-adjusted to today's share basis),
 "sharesOutstanding": weighted-average DILUTED share count from the company's MOST RECENT QUARTERLY report (10-Q, or the latest interim/half-year report outside the US), in MILLIONS (express per listed security, i.e. ADR-equivalents for ADRs),
 "sharesAsOf": "quarter ended YYYY-MM-DD" for that share count,
 "cash": cash plus short-term investments in MILLIONS of reporting currency, latest balance sheet,
 "totalDebt": short plus long-term debt in MILLIONS of reporting currency, latest balance sheet,
 "balanceSheetDate": "YYYY-MM",
 "currentNetMargin": latest fiscal-year net margin as a decimal,
 "optimizedMargin": decimal net margin this business could sustain at maturity if run to maximize profit from its revenue (use industry peers at maturity),
 "marginRationale": "one short sentence",
 "maturity": one of "hyper-growth","high-growth","growth","mature","declining",
 "projections": [ {"source":"firm or consensus provider name","g1":decimal,"g3":decimal,"g5":decimal,"note":"short basis, e.g. FY2027 revenue estimate $X","url":null} ],
 "dataAsOf": "YYYY-MM of the newest data you used",
 "caveats": "one short sentence on anything uncertain, or null"
}
For "projections": list every analyst revenue growth projection you know for this company: the consensus, the high and low estimates, and each named broker or research firm. g1 is next-fiscal-year revenue growth; g3 and g5 are annualized revenue CAGRs over 3 and 5 years; all are measured from the last completed fiscal year in revenueHistory. Use null for horizons a source does not cover. Growth rates are decimals (0.15 = 15%).

result.name: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A.
result.exchange: B3 São Paulo (SANB11 units); ticker BSBR is the NYSE ADR (1 ADS = 1 unit = 1 common + 1 preferred share)
result.marginRationale: FY2025 IFRS profit attributable to the parent was R$12,766M on total income of R$74,997M (17.0%), held down by R$29.5bn of credit impairments; management targets a return to about 20% ROE by 2028 (recurring ROAE was 12.5% in 2Q26), and higher-return Itaú earned 26.7% of IFRS operating revenues in 2025, so about 22% looks sustainable at maturity.

projections.note: FY2026 revenue estimate R$85.20bn (6 analysts) against the consensus basis of R$83.51bn for FY2025 (a BRGAAP/managerial measure, not IFRS total income of R$74,997M), so growth is measured on the consensus's own basis. IFRS total income in H1 2026 was R$37,879M, down 0.7% on H1 2025.
FY2026 high revenue estimate R$86.1bn on the same consensus basis
FY2026 low revenue estimate R$84.5bn on the same consensus basis; consensus FY2026 EPS is down 11.7%

result.caveats: Revenue is IFRS total income from the FY2022, FY2024 and FY2025 Form 20-Fs. Shares are per ADS/unit (common plus preferred divided by two): FY2020-FY2022 are the reported diluted averages, and FY2023-FY2025 are the basic averages, because the reported diluted common counts (e.g. 4,403,869 thousand for 2023) exceed the shares in issue. The latest count is the 7,488M shares outstanding excluding treasury at June 30, 2026 from the 2Q26 release, because the IFRS interim EPS note could not be read. Cash is the cash line, and debt is marketable debt securities plus debt instruments eligible as capital at June 30, 2026, both operating items for a bank. Price is the NYSE close of Oct 16, 2026, at USD/BRL 5.0629. On July 30, 2026, Banco Santander S.A. (89.7% owner) announced an exchange offer of 0.4056 SAN shares per BSBR ADS, which it expects to complete in H1 2027.
